intent: Trace how Facebook's share value in euros changed over the period under the new business model and compare its starting and ending levels.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
How did Facebook's share value in euros change over the period, and how do its starting and ending levels compare?
The ending share value (50.0 €) is higher than the starting share value (38.0 €), an increase of 12.0 €.

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: Facebook's share value in euros fluctuated over the period, starting at 38.0 €, reaching a maximum of 63.7 €, and ending at 50.0 €.
units.computation: Identify first value (point_order 1 = 38.0), maximum value (point_order 25 = 63.7), and last value (point_order 34 = 50.0) from the single series; describe overall fluctuation.
accept: Mentions the share value started at 38.0 €
Mentions the share value ended at 50.0 €
Mentions the share value reached a peak of 63.7 €
Describes the path as fluctuating or non-monotonic
reject: Omits the starting or ending level
Uses a peak value other than 63.7 €

units.claim: The ending share value (50.0 €) is higher than the starting share value (38.0 €), an increase of 12.0 €.
units.computation: Compare last value (50.0) to first value (38.0); absolute difference = 50.0 - 38.0 = 12.0 €.
accept: States the ending level is higher than the starting level
reject: States the ending level is lower than the starting level

review_notes: The table has a single series labeled '50€' under entity; treated as Facebook share value in euros per the intent.
